snippet.title: Take Something Literally 2 full walkthrough part 1/2 puzzles 1-20
snippet.description:
Take Something Literally 2 full walkthrough part 1/2, 25 puzzles.

Play TSL2 here : https://benoitfreslon.itch.io/take-something-literally-2

Designed & developed by Benoit Freslon
http://www.benoitfreslon.com

Music by : Pascal Freslon aka "Caloun"
http://www.myspace.com/caloun

2nd part: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jb7S5x2NFGQ

If you want to bookmark the rewards click on the "Watch on Youtube" button inside the video.

Play the original game:
http://www.kongregate.com/games/badben/take-something-literally
